entities.name: Cleopatra II of Egypt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cleopatra II Philometor Soteira was Queen consort of Ptolemaic Egypt from 175 to 170 BC as wife of Ptolemy VI Philometor, and then Queen regnant since 170 BC as co-ruler with her two successive brother-husbands, her daughter, and her grandson.
